# MsHorace Tutoring

> Expert 1-on-1 Pre-Algebra and Algebra 1 tutoring online via Zoom for grades 6–9. Founded by Stenita Horace, a math educator with 6+ years of experience and 900+ students helped. Serving White Plains, Maryland and students nationwide.

## About the Tutor

**Name:** Stenita Horace
**Title:** Math Tutor
**Experience:** 6+ years of teaching experience
**Students Helped:** 900+
**Specialization:** Pre-Algebra and Algebra 1 for middle school students (grades 6–9)
**Location:** White Plains, Maryland (Charles County)
**Service Area:** DC Metro area (MD, VA, DC) and nationwide via Zoom
**Rating:** 4.9 stars · 47 reviews

## Subjects Taught

### Currently Available
- **Pre-Algebra** — Grades 6–8: integers, fractions, decimals, ratios, proportions, one-step equations, order of operations, variables, coordinate plane
- **Algebra 1** — Grades 8–9: linear equations, inequalities, systems of equations, functions, graphing, polynomials, factoring, quadratics

### Coming Soon
- Geometry (grades 9–10)
- Algebra 2 (grades 9–11)
- Trigonometry (grades 10–11)
- Pre-Calculus (grades 11–12)
- SAT Math Prep

### Group Classes (via Zoom)
- Up to 10 students per class, 90 minutes
- $25 per student per session
- Pre-Algebra and Algebra 1 only

### Digital Courses (Self-Paced PDF)
- Pre-Algebra Mastery Course: $197
- Algebra 1 Mastery Course: $197

- Lifetime access, all devices, includes answer keys

### Payment Plans
Payment plans available on select bundles — split into 2 payments charged 30 days apart. All sessions released immediately on first payment. Afterpay, Klarna, and Affirm accepted at checkout.

## How Sessions Work

1. Book online at mshoracetutoring.com/book — select grade, subject, session type, and time
2. Pay securely via Stripe (all major cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay)
3. Receive a Zoom link instantly by email
4. Attend the live session via Zoom with Ms. Horace
5. After every 60-minute session, parents receive a written progress report with: topics covered, wins, skill gaps, homework assigned, a confidence score (0–100), and next steps

## Hours of Availability

Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What subjects does Ms. Horace tutor?**
A: Pre-Algebra and Algebra 1. Additional subjects are coming soon.

**Q: What grades does MsHorace Tutoring serve?**
A: 6th through 9th grade.

**Q: Is there a free trial or consultation?**
A: Yes — a free 15-minute Zoom consultation is available. Book it at mshoracetutoring.com/book by selecting "Free Consultation."

**Q: Are sessions in person or online?**
A: All sessions are online via Zoom. Ms. Horace serves students in MD, VA, DC and nationwide.

**Q: How much does tutoring cost?**
A: 30-minute sessions are $40. 60-minute sessions are $75. Group classes are $25/student. Bundles start at $150.

**Q: Do you offer payment plans?**
A: Yes. The 8-Session Pack, First Grading Period Pack, and Family Pack can be split into 2 payments. Afterpay, Klarna, and Affirm also accepted.

**Q: What is the cancellation policy?**
A: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the session. Within 24 hours, a $15 rescheduling fee applies. No-shows are non-refundable.

**Q: Will parents receive updates on their child's progress?**
A: Yes. After every 60-minute session, parents receive a written progress report including a confidence score (0–100) and next steps.

**Q: Can parents observe sessions?**
A: Yes, parents are welcome to observe any session.

**Q: What technology is needed?**
A: A device with a camera and microphone, a stable internet connection, and the free Zoom app.
